terms.gloss: the tenth part, a tithe: as an offering to a god, or as a tax on landholders in the provinces
evidence: Liv. 5.21: decumam partem praedae voveō (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: a farmer of the tithes, a tithe-collector; as an adjective (decumānus, -a, -um), of tithes, or of the tenth cohort: porta decumāna, the rear gate of a camp

phrases.latin: tibi hinc decumam partem praedae voveō
phrases.english: to you I vow a tenth part of the spoil from here

phrases.latin: inter arātōrēs et decumānōs lēge frūmentāriā, quam Hierōnicam appellant, jūdicia fīunt
phrases.english: between the farmers and the tithe-collectors cases are tried under the corn law that they call Hiero’s
